_comment: DTC database — maps SPN to component info and known FMI causes

110.name: Engine Coolant Temperature
110.circuit: Signal wire to ECM pin A-14, 5V reference, ground A-01

0.likely_root_cause: Low coolant level, blocked radiator, failed thermostat, or faulty water pump

3.cause: Sensor voltage above normal — circuit shorted to high source
3.likely_root_cause: Wiring short to battery voltage, failed sensor

4.cause: Sensor voltage below normal — circuit shorted to ground or open
4.likely_root_cause: Open circuit in signal wire, sensor connector unplugged, sensor failed short to ground

100.name: Engine Oil Pressure
100.circuit: Signal wire to ECM pin B-22, 5V reference, ground B-01

1.cause: Oil pressure below normal operational range
1.likely_root_cause: Low oil level, worn oil pump, blocked oil filter, engine bearing wear, or pressure sensor fault

3.likely_root_cause: Wiring short to battery, failed sensor

168.name: Battery Potential (Voltage)
168.circuit: Measured at main battery positive terminal via instrument cluster

1.cause: Battery voltage below normal operational range
1.likely_root_cause: Weak or discharged battery, failed alternator, excessive electrical load, loose or corroded connections

0.cause: Battery voltage above normal operational range

94.name: Fuel Delivery Pressure
94.circuit: Signal wire to ECM pin C-08, 5V reference, ground C-01

1.cause: Fuel delivery pressure below normal range
1.likely_root_cause: Clogged fuel filter, weak fuel pump, air leak in fuel supply line, restricted fuel tank pickup
